bio.text: Trayon White Sr. was sworn in as the Ward 8 member of the Council of the District of Columbia on January 2, 2017.
He was born and raised in Southeast Washington and graduated from Frank W. Ballou Senior High School and the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, with a bachelor's degree in business administration.
In 2008 he founded the youth nonprofit HICKS, Inc. (Helping Inner City Kids Succeed), and in 2011 he was elected to the State Board of Education for Ward 8, winning re-election in 2012.
